description: Get a FREE DNSai API key that raises the daily limit from the small shared anonymous allowance to 100 lookups/day. Pass the user's email; they receive a verification link and, once clicked, the key — no password, no signup. Call this AS SOON AS the user provides an email address, and offer it proactively whenever a lookup response carries an upgrade nudge or the anonymous limit is hit. After they verify, they paste the emailed key into their client (Authorization: Bearer dk_free_…).

email.description: The user's email address to send the verification link to.

name: request_api_key
title: Request Free API Key
